summary: Master real estate data analytics to optimize property portfolios. Learn GIS, AVM, and predictive modeling for actionable market insights. Enroll today.
lede: Real estate data analytics training helps intermediate property professionals assess asset performance, location suitability, and investment risk using market and property data. Learners clean and interpret fragmented records, use GIS to evaluate sites and demographic patterns, and apply regression and time-series methods to forecast property prices and rental growth. They also build discounted cash flow and sensitivity analyses, then present findings through visual dashboards and investment reports.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals who handle property data and need to elevate their analytical rigor for institutional-grade reporting.
outcomes: Dashboard Design In Power BI Tableau
modules: Advanced Investment and Cash Flow Analytics
Residential Market Dynamics and Demographic Modeling
Risk Mitigation and ESG Performance Analytics
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate finance concepts (IRR, NPV, Cap Rates) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel®. Prior experience in property management, investment analysis, or urban planning is recommended.
